name: Tandoori Guys
notes: Own per-branch static site (San Marcos storefront subdomain of tandooriguyssd.com; platform is iMenu4u, not 'Olo' - an earlier substring grep of 'olo' matched only unrelated words like 'dolore'). Every section parsed cleanly from plain text except 'Meat Lover': that section's dish-card prices were wrapped in HTML comments (stale/placeholder $8.00 values, e.g. ) and were NOT used. Instead its own visible header text states the real current pricing directly: 'Chicken-17, Lamb-19, Fish/Shrimp-19' applied per protein choice across the section's 8 dish styles (Butter, Karahi, Korma, Tikka Masala, Curry, Saag, Vindaloo, Rogan Josh) - 24 dish entries. Two Goat-based dish names in that section (Goat Curry, Goat Pepper Fry) had no applicable price anywhere and were dropped rather than guessed.
